device.name: VMAS balance scenario behind the Gymnasium wrapper

facts.text: VMAS describes itself as a vectorized differentiable simulator designed for efficient MARL benchmarking
make_env loads the named scenario, constructs an Environment and returns the requested wrapper, or the Environment itself when wrapper is None
The Gymnasium wrapper requires gymnasium and shimmy and raises ImportError when either is absent
The Gymnasium wrapper serves one vectorized environment only: it asserts num_envs == 1 and terminated_truncated
GymnasiumWrapper.reset(seed, options) seeds the wrapped Environment and resets environment 0; options is accepted and not used
GymnasiumWrapper.step converts the per-agent action list, steps the wrapped Environment and returns obs, rewards, terminated, truncated and info
GymnasiumWrapper converts the wrapped Environment's observation and action spaces with shimmy's _convert_space
The balance scenario defaults to 3 agents and constructs agent_0, agent_1 and agent_2 with u_multiplier=0.7
An Agent uses Holonomic dynamics by default and takes its action size from the dynamics' needed_action_size
Holonomic.needed_action_size is 2, so each balance agent has a two-value action
The default Agent action range u_range is 1.0

The balance observation concatenates agent position, velocity, package-relative position, line-relative position, package-goal offset, package velocity, line velocity, line angular velocity and line rotation
World's default simulation timestep dt is 0.1 s
The balance scenario constructs the World with gravity (0.0, -0.05) and y_semidim 1 and does not override dt

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds the fake's Python random generator and repeats a start state; the upstream wrapper calls Environment.seed, which seeds torch, numpy and Python random, so the same seed does not reproduce the upstream trajectory in this fake

gaps: no contact or actuator model: the placeholder transition ignores VMAS's collision response, gravity, friction and joint forces, and applies the action as an ideal velocity increment
the fake is not the upstream PyTorch rigid-body engine: its start states, integration and rewards are placeholder test data and were never compared with a VMAS run
one scalar reward: GymnasiumWrapper.step returns one reward per agent, while cap.world.step.v1 carries a single number, so the fake returns the sum of its placeholder per-agent rewards
action shape: the wrapper's step takes a list of per-agent actions, while the bridge sends the Dict action keyed by agent name; the fake accepts both
reset: the wrapper calls Environment.reset_at(index=0) and sets the seed through Environment.seed; the fake resets its whole scalar state and has no vectorized batch dimension
no rendering, no lidar, no communication channel and no snapshot/restore: the Environment exposes no get_state/set_state and the fake declares none
the sim path was not run: torch, gymnasium and shimmy are not installed where the gate runs, and no gymnasium environment with the id vmas:balance is registered

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
